info.title: OpenAsy Errors API
info.summary: Application errors grouped into issues, with stack traces, releases and regressions.
info.description:
Every screen of errors uses this API, and so can your scripts (ADR 0014). Within `/api/v1` changes are additive only; anything removed is deprecated first (ADR 0024). Errors use Problem Details (RFC 9457).

Applications send events with a project's key (`x-errors-key`). Everything else takes the session of a signed-in person or an API token, and each operation names the role it needs (`x-openasy-role`: viewer, editor, admin; ADR 0003).

Sign-in, members and API tokens are under `/api/v1/auth`, provided by [@openasy/auth](https://github.com/openasy/auth#routes).

tags.name: Issues
tags.description: Events grouped by what went wrong and where.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: The applications that send events, and their keys.

tags.name: Releases
tags.description: Versions as they were seen in events.

tags.name: Product
tags.description: Version and overview of this errors.

201.description: Stored and grouped into an issue.

429.description: Over the project's events a minute. Nothing was stored.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the project may send again.

201.description: Created. The key is in this answer and nowhere else.

delete.description:
Deletes its issues, events and releases.

Needs the admin role.

201.description: The new key, shown once. The old one stops working at once.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Only issues seen in this environment.

parameters.name: release
parameters.description: Only issues seen in this release.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches the title or the culprit.

200.description: The issue with its latest events, releases and environments.

patch.summary: Resolve, ignore or reopen an issue
patch.description:
`resolved` (with the release that ships the fix) reopens as a regression if the issue happens again. `ignored` keeps it quiet however often it happens.

Needs the editor role.

get.description:
Issues first seen on each of the last 14 days, unresolved issues by level and by project, and the unresolved issues with the most events in the last 7 days.

Needs the viewer role.

200.description: From OPENASY_PRODUCTS, for the product switcher.
Metrics in the Prometheus text format.

session.name: __Host-openasy-session
session.description: The browser session after signing in (`openasy-session` when errors runs on plain http://localhost). Requests that change something must come from the errors origin.

apiToken.description: An API token created under Settings → API tokens (`oa_errors_...`): one role, always an expiry (ADR 0003).

adminToken.description: Only when errors is started by its tests or a local script: one shared token with the admin role. A production install does not have it.

projectKey.name: x-errors-key
projectKey.description: A project's key (`ek_...`), shown once when the project is created or its key is replaced.

projectBearer.description: The same key as a bearer token, for clients that cannot set another header.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 Problem Details.

id.description: The product, as OpenAsy names it.

url.description: The address people open it at.

in_app.description: True for your own code. Grouping uses the last three of these.

Event.description: Send a `message`, an `exception`, or both. Anything else is refused: request bodies, headers, cookies and personal data about the user are not part of an event.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 or Unix seconds. Defaults to now; not more than a day ahead.

fingerprint.description: Group events your own way instead of by exception type and the last three frames of your code.

regression.description: The issue was resolved and this event reopened it.

keyPrefix.description: The first characters of the key, to tell keys apart. The key itself is shown once.

key.description: Send it as `x-errors-key` or as a bearer token. Shown once; kept only as a hash.

nextCursor.description: Pass the previous page's nextCursor to get the next page.

rateLimit.description: Events a minute. Defaults to ERRORS_RATE_LIMIT.

culprit.description: The most recent frame of your own code.

resolvedIn.description: The release the fix was meant for. Kept when the issue comes back.

regression.description: Set when a resolved issue happened again; `in` is the release it came back in.

nextCursor.description: Pass the previous page's nextCursor to get the next page.

latestEvents.description: The latest 20 events with their stack traces, newest first.

release.description: Only with `resolved`: the release the fix ships in.

newIssues.description: Issues whose first event came from this release.

nextCursor.description: Pass the previous page's nextCursor to get the next page.

regressions.description: Unresolved issues that came back after being fixed.

environments.description: Every environment an issue was seen in, for the issue list's filter.

EventDays.description: Events on each of the last 14 days (UTC), oldest first. Counted as events arrive, so days before the count was added show 0.

newIssues.description: Oldest first; the last is today (UTC).
